#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Single repo-pinned poll of every review surface (reviews, issue + inline comments,
# review threads); one snapshot serves both reviewers, Augment and Codex.
# Raw payloads stay in files (large reviews exceed ARG_MAX).
# Classification/backoff belong to superclaude.pr_submit, not this adapter.
set -euo pipefail

die() { printf 'poll-augment-review: %s\n' "$1" >&2; exit "${2:-1}"; }
PR=""
REPO=""
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
        --pr) PR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
        --repo) REPO="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
        *) die "unknown argument: $1" 2 ;;
    esac
done
[[ "$PR" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]] || die "missing/invalid --pr <N>" 2
command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "gh CLI not found on PATH" 2
command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "jq not found on PATH" 2
REPO="${REPO:-$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null | sed -E 's#^ssh://[^/]+/##; s#^git@[^:]+:##; s#^https?://[^/]+/##; s#\.git$##' || true)}"
[ -n "$REPO" ] || REPO="$(gh repo view --json nameWithOwner -q .nameWithOwner 2>/dev/null || true)"
[ -n "$REPO" ] || die "could not resolve target repo (pass --repo <owner/repo>)" 2

failed_poll() {
    jq -nc --argjson pr "$PR" '{pr:$pr, head_sha:null, state:"polling",
        reviews_ok:false, comments_ok:false, threads_ok:false, reviews:[], comments:[], threads:[]}'
    exit 0
}
_tmp="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/poll-augment.XXXXXX")" || failed_poll

import json, subprocess, sys, time
from superclaude.pr_submit import (
    DetectionContract, classify, classify_codex, reviewer_activity,
    augment_marker_defect, actionable_finding_comments, codex_finding_comments,
)

c = DetectionContract.for_arming()
POLL = "/home/coder/.claude/skills/sc-pr-submit-protocol/scripts/poll-augment-review.sh"
start = time.time()
budget = int(sys.argv[1])
last = None
while True:
    out = subprocess.run(["bash", POLL, "--pr", "654", "--repo", "IronbellyOrg/IronClaude"],
                         capture_output=True, text=True)
    if out.returncode != 0:
        print("POLL_FAIL", out.stderr); sys.exit(1)
    p = json.loads(out.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1])
    head = p.get("head_sha")
    a = classify(p, c, watermark=None, current_head_sha=head)
    x = classify_codex(p, c, watermark=None, current_head_sha=head)
    act = reviewer_activity(p, c)
    md = augment_marker_defect(p, c, watermark=None, current_head_sha=head)
    last = (a, x, act, md)
    el = time.time() - start
    print(f"t={int(el)} augment={a} codex={x} activity={act} defect={md}", flush=True)
    if a != "polling" or x != "polling":
        json.dump(p, open("/tmp/pr654-payload.json", "w"))
        break
    if el >= budget:
        json.dump(p, open("/tmp/pr654-payload.json", "w"))
        break
    time.sleep(30)
